notes.title: Free to Play Announcement + A Letter from the Devs
notes.notes:
Greetings Farmer-Warriors!

We're super excited to announce that our game is [b]FREE[/b] on Steam!

We’d like to give a sincere thank you to everyone who has played and supported our game. Our game was a labour of love, created during our final year of game design at university. We're incredibly proud of the work we put into it and so grateful for the interest and support you’ve shown.

While we had hoped to expand, polish, and add more content, many of our team members have moved on to other goals and commitments. Those of us still working on the project want to make our future ideas a reality, but it’s going to take some time.

In the meantime, we want everyone interested to experience our game for free. We hope this brings in new players to enjoy what we've created and gives our current and future players more people to play with.

A huge thanks to our loyal players and everyone who has purchased our game. If we resume development in the future, we'll find ways to show our appreciation for your support.

Thanks for playing!

Happy Farming,
Lemon Scope Studios

notes.title: Summer Sale
notes.notes:
Greetings farmer-warriors and newcomers! During the Steam Summer Sale, you can get Harvest Havoc 70% off from today until July 11 at 10am Pacific Time. Spread the word and start playing with your friends!

[b]IMPORTANT:[/b] We are considering the development of local/split-screen multiplayer. However, details are still being discussed and it could be months before anything is confirmed. Keep this in mind if you are looking to get multiple copies for others in the same household

notes.title: New Community Discord
notes.notes:
Greetings Farmer-warriors! 

We've realised that some players have found it tough to find players to connect and play with, but we've got you covered now! Use the link below to join our new official Harvest Havoc Discord server.

This server is a place for you to not only find others to play and chat with, but keep up with any news or discounts as well as asking us any questions. It's a little empty now but give it some time to grow into a place filled with farmer-warriors. 

See you on the server! 

https://discord.gg/ckttFAn8TJ

notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
We are please to announcement that Harvest Havoc is now available to purchase. For this first week, it is available at 30% off.

Gather your friends, grow some crops, and battle it out to determine who is the ultimate farmer-warrior.

notes.title: Harvest Havoc Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello farmer-warriors!

We're thrilled to announce that Harvest Havoc is scheduled for release at the end of this week, on December 1st, 12:00pm NZDT (3:00pm PST).
